about: Pinned commits for the NB run (muster-run v2). bootstrap.ps1 / bootstrap.sh clone each repo into the nested layout and check out the pin as the named local branch (default main). BHD's changes are commits at the pins (branch bhd/nb), so there are no patches or overlay files. Run steps (mx-e2e.ps1, Phase 3): E1-E6, E8.5 (EC upload), E7, E8 (+ EO ledger and package), E8B (bundle.mjs), E8F (forced-failure run; needs the Stamper --force-fail flag, ces-mono 6e9e35e or later), E9. Until the bhd/nb branches are pushed to the org, a fresh clone from the org cannot reach the ces-muster pin: rerun against existing clones, or pass a mirror origin (bootstrap v2, -Origin).
origin_note: bootstrap -Origin (bootstrap.sh --origin) takes a git URL prefix or a local directory of <repo>.git bare mirrors; omitted, it is the org above. Until the bhd/nb push is approved, -Origin C:\ces-nb\mirror (made by nb-tools make-mirror.ps1) is the local proof path for V24.
